52. Max of Consecutive Pairs

40

Medium  Topics

Problem Statement:
Given a number N followed by N elements for every 2 consecutive numbers print the maximum of the 2.
input_spec: The input consists of an integer N, followed by N elements. N is an integer such that N <= 100000, implying an O(n) time complexity solution is expected.
output_spec: The output is a space-separated sequence of the maximums of every two consecutive numbers from the input.
